purpose: Third external stress test: a cross-species (human, in vitro) CD34+ HSPC megakaryocyte differentiation time course, restricted to the untreated/DMSO vehicle trajectory. Locked before any training run so endpoint selection cannot follow results.
system: in vitro CD34+ HSPC megakaryocyte differentiation (single donor)

selected_files.name: GSE305979_day1-7_demuxed_counts.h5ad
selected_files.role: demultiplexed singlet counts with CMO well/treatment assignments

excluded_files.name: GSE305979_day0-7_normalized_counts_with_celltype_annotations.h5ad
excluded_files.reason: protocol re-normalizes from counts with fit-on-train statistics; the 2.98 GB object adds size only

excluded_files.name: GSE305979_day1-7_raw_counts.h5ad
excluded_files.reason: pre-demultiplexing object cannot separate vehicle wells

condition_filter: vehicle/untreated trajectory only (day 0 untreated plus DMSO vehicle wells); compound-treated wells excluded from the primary analysis and reserved as an independent perturbation stress test
time_unit_note: H5AD TIMEPOINT_HOURS divided by 24; division must be integral or conversion stops
replicate_note: single donor; cells nested within CMO well and library; no donor-level inference. Protocol/seed-level uncertainty only.

training_contract.entry_point_policy: unmodified; the training script records its own sha256
training_contract.device_rationale: GPU measured 2.53x slower on this workload (local benchmark; execution trace excluded); frozen internal and external runs are CPU

baselines_required: classical baseline family (HGB/MLP) before any claim upgrade
pure_mse_policy: only if the primary endpoint survives the three-seed review
random_gene_set_policy: not default; keep the internal random-null as the methodological control unless a cross-dataset pathway-specific claim is attempted
stopping_rules: demuxed file fails HDF5 integrity or size check
TIMEPOINT_HOURS values are not whole days
vehicle wells cannot be identified unambiguously from the demuxed obs
gene panels fail to intersect below an interpretable overlap
train/holdout timepoint coverage missing after the vehicle filter
isolation: writes only ext_gse305979_* tagged outputs under data/leworld_input_gse305979 and artifacts/results; never touches the frozen internal result, the manuscript, reviewer controls, or the submission gate
